text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the grand finale of the year, the 
'Arima Kinen'! A lineup even more 
star-studded than the 'Japan Cup' has 
gathered here today.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
First, here are the Umamusume who also ran 
in the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Symboli Kris S, Narita Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
No Reason, Air Shakur. And in addition to 
them...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, everyone♪ I'll be sure to 
show you an honorable race!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion! She has claimed victory in 
the Shuka Sho completely undefeated, and 
has made it this far!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
OK! OK! What a lively bunch we have 
gathered here! It'll be worth sinking 
them.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City! The hardworking captain 
beloved by her many crewmates. And now—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ah, am I not out of place here...? I 
only won the Kikuka Sho by chance, after 
all~.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle! Always claiming to be 
ordinary, she's the lucky horse girl who 
pulled off a massive upset.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Also drawing massive attention this time 
is—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... My partner... How could this 
happen...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Never expected to get an eye-popping 
present sent back in return.
choice_data_list: Yeah, as expected of you, Tsuzuki.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: That bastard, messing with me. Still—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you really delivered, didn't ya? 
That's what I'm talking about.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ALRIIIGHT! Let's do this!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
An exceptionally loud cheer! Jungle Pocket 
takes center stage once again today. And 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rivals who know all of that inside out 
stand in your way. First is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe! She makes her racing 
comeback following the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Cafe. If you're able to run, that's 
what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I don't know how well I can do, 
but I shall accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Until you showed up, it was still 
plausible. But I never thought...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And appearing for the first time since 
last year's Satsuki Sho! That light has 
not yet faded!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what the hell happened. 
Still... good of you to show up, Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure it's really going to be all 
right, though?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Are you okay?" How should I know? There 
are no guarantees. But—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"In the first place, we were never asking 
for guarantees. Isn't that right?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Neither you, nor I, nor Cafe! None of us 
want some guaranteed tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Staking everything on a single moment to 
reach our goal... That is who we are, is 
it not?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. That's exactly right. We are—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Grab it even if you fall! If you can't 
grab it, there's no point in living! 
They're just that kind of hopeless bunch."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... By the way, Pokke-kun. With 
Tsuduki-kun's help, we presented you with 
a "rematch" as a gift.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In return, there is something I would like 
to receive.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —What's this?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Victory. If you ask whether that is my 
purpose for running, the answer is no. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
When I run at top speed, victory will 
naturally follow anyway. You don't mind, 
do you?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh, take whatever you want. If you're 
able to take it, that is.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Take it from me by force. If you're the 
guys I know, you ought to be able to.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Tachyon, Cafe! Finally, finally, 
finally, finally, finally—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
With the title of strongest on the 
line—let's settle this!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cast is assembled. More than 
assembled, in fact. This is the dream 
jungle where revived beasts gather.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Striving to be the true strongest, Jungle 
Pocket charges forward now.
